llm_guided_adaptation.name: LLM-guided adaptation
llm_guided_adaptation.round_rationale: With only one 6-component reference group currently available (ev-5487fe4324d101f29b843e4a) and a notable gap in baseline force MAE between the two pretrained potentials (0.156736 eV/A in ev-bda198a367a805d34a7e23b8 vs 0.05277 eV/A in ev-da310d3c6eac03161ce0cf35), Round 1 prioritizes maximum committee force disagreement (ev-2ea1b22dead00739b1dbe3e4) across chemically complementary 4-component subsystems. Selecting E4-BCC-1077 (Ta-Hf-Zr-Ti, max disagreement 0.09725 eV/A) and E4-BCC-0582 (Nb-V-Hf-Ti, disagreement 0.09238 eV/A) spans all six alloy elements across two distinct quaternary groups with high SOAP novelty, maximally stressing the transferability hypothesis.

decisions.scientific_question: Do pretrained UMA and MACE potentials maintain force accuracy within the 0.1 eV/A threshold at the point of maximum committee force disagreement (0.09725 eV/A) in a 4-component V-free and Nb-free Ta-Hf-Zr-Ti alloy?
decisions.informativeness: E4-BCC-1077 exhibits the highest committee force disagreement in the entire 84-candidate pool (0.09725 eV/A) and high SOAP novelty (0.21187) relative to the single existing 6-component reference group. Evaluating DFT forces here provides the most stringent test of inter-model disagreement and identifies which model fails when V and Nb are absent.
decisions.expected_effect: If both models show force MAE below 0.1 eV/A despite maximum committee disagreement, the transferability hypothesis is strongly supported; if one or both exceed 0.1 eV/A, it falsifies broad transferability for at least one potential and provides high-leverage training data.
decisions.uncertainty_diversity_considerations: Maximizes epistemic uncertainty via peak committee disagreement while exploring a 4-component subsystem (Ta-Hf-Zr-Ti) enriched in Ta, Zr, and Ti.

decisions.scientific_question: How well do pretrained potentials transfer force predictions to a complementary V- and Nb-rich 4-component alloy (Nb-V-Hf-Ti) that lacks Ta and Zr and exhibits high committee disagreement (0.09238 eV/A)?
decisions.informativeness: E4-BCC-0582 tests the chemical species missing in E4-BCC-1077 (specifically Nb and V, which creates large atomic-size mismatch with Hf) while maintaining very high committee force disagreement (0.09238 eV/A, well above the pool median of 0.0823 eV/A) and substantial SOAP novelty (0.17655).
decisions.expected_effect: Tests whether force errors correlate with V/Hf local lattice distortions in Ta/Zr-free compositions, directly probing whether the baseline force MAE differences (0.156736 eV/A vs 0.05277 eV/A) persist in distinct 4-component subsystems.
decisions.uncertainty_diversity_considerations: Provides strong compositional orthogonality to E4-BCC-1077 (testing Nb-V-Hf-Ti vs Ta-Hf-Zr-Ti) while still targeting the upper tail of committee uncertainty.
